**1) VISUAL MEDIUM:** Real footage throughout — a compilation/countdown video made of real TikTok clips (people, animals, food, piano). No game engine content, no HUD; each frame has a consistent red title banner and white caption text overlaid by the compiler.

**2) ON-SCREEN TEXT (frame by frame):**

- F12: "Top 15 Most Liked TikToks" / "🥈 julencohen_piano: 62.9M ❤️"

**3) VISUAL ARC:** Each frame is a different ranked clip, going up the like-count ladder: a girl in a cat-ear headband → a blurry dark clip → a puppy in water → Lamine Yamal in a cap → extreme-close-up green lips biting a lime → rabbits on a lawn → a bowl of strawberries/chocolate → a boy taking a mirror selfie → a man in a coat outdoors → a kid at a piano in a glass-roofed hall ("THIS ONE?") → a corgi on a deck → three boys at a window playing piano. Location, subject, and palette change every frame; like counts climb steadily from 46.3M to 62.9M.

**4) USERNAME/WATERMARK:** None visible beyond the compiled creators' handles listed in the captions (e.g., "julencohen_piano", "vantoan__"); no compiler watermark readable.

**5) STORY GUESS:** A countdown compilation ranking the most-liked TikToks of all time, counting up from #15 toward #1 by likes.
